claim.value: Separating queue wait, worker execution, object-read and upload timing is proposed to identify where additional time accumulates, where comparable trace spans exist.
claim.scope: Conditional phase-level diagnosis; applicability depends on comparable spans.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the timing separation, diagnostic purpose and comparability condition.

signal_basis.value: Comparable trace spans expose timing separately for queue wait, worker execution, object reads and upload. Missing spans provide no evidence of phase duration.
signal_basis.scope: Timing observations for phases with comparable trace coverage.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the phase timing observations and the limitation imposed by missing spans.
No additional unresolved empirical relation is needed for this bounded descriptive diagnosis.

rationale: Given comparable phase timings, their differences identify which observed phases accumulate additional elapsed time. This licenses the stated diagnostic purpose without establishing an underlying cause or explaining unobserved phases.
uncertainty: Localization remains limited to comparable observed spans; missing spans leave gaps.
